Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for registering for our 'Scaling LLM Inference' webinar yesterday — really appreciate you joining. I wanted to follow up and offer a short (15–20 minute) demo that focuses on the parts you flagged during Q&A: predictable latency for batch jobs and model routing across regions.

If you have 20 minutes this week, can you pick a slot here: https://calendly.com/ben-carter/20min ? If none of the times work, tell me a handful of windows and I’ll coordinate.

I’ve attached the event roster we pulled so you can confirm who attended from your side.

Quick note: copying Tessa (our Solutions Lead) — she can join if you want a technical deep-dive.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise SDR | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

- Very high-level architecture notes (how you handle multi-model fallbacks across regions)
- Any quantization/precision tradeoffs you recommend for throughput-sensitive workloads

Cc’ing Sanjay — he’ll be the technical attendee. Sanjay, do afternoons next week (Dec 7–9) work for you?
